name: Strahnbrad Mystery
objectiveText: Solve the mystery of Strahnbrad and report your findings in town in Hillsbrad.   Discover the fiery mystery of Strahnbrad  ( 1 ) Singed Note  ( 1 )

objectives.name: Discover the fiery mystery of Strahnbrad

objectiveRows.text: Discover the fiery mystery of Strahnbrad

comments.body:
It is the same as the Hot Streak rune from SoD. 
You have to get a mage to flamestrike ontop of the two bellows to summon a fire elemental. 
Kill it to complete the quest. 
Quest starts from note dropped by the casters in the town.
Hey, it works with rain of fire too, and probably with any fire damage (to make the elemental spawn).
Also works with shaman searing totem + fire nova

Warlock Rain of Fire worked fine, the key is use it inside the blacksmith shop where the forge vents are. I tried using a campfire but you can't make one inside. I tried a campfire outside and that didn't work. I also tried getting the mage mob to shoot fireballs at me all over the area, no help.
The conclusion is an aoe fire spell works but i can't see another way.

Can confirm this drops for alliance and the quest is attainable by the alliance. I have added a screenshot for extra proof.

Mine dropped from an Argus Shadow Mage on Beta
